questions.question: What is the difference between growth and development? Give an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: Growth means getting bigger, like a bean seedling getting taller or a chick getting heavier. Development means changing into a new form or learning new abilities, like a seed germinating and flowering, a chick growing feathers or a baby learning to walk.

questions.question: Describe the stages a bean plant goes through as it develops.
questions.expected_answer: A dry seed gets water and warmth and germinates: a root grows down and a shoot grows up. Leaves open and the seedling grows into a young plant, then an adult plant that flowers. The flowers become pods with new seeds inside.

questions.question: What is metamorphosis? Give one example.
questions.expected_answer: Metamorphosis is a big change in body shape as an animal develops. A frog changes from egg to tadpole with a tail and gills, then grows legs, loses its tail and becomes a frog. A butterfly changes from egg to caterpillar to pupa to butterfly.
